fields.subject: Postgres Connection Settings
fields.where: the host has registered PostgreSQL services, binding the PgGlobalSettings configuration section to PgGlobalPropertiesOptions
fields.trigger: the PgDatabases or PgShardSets collection is constructed
fields.response: supply the bound PgGlobalPropertiesOptions value (a PgConnectionPropertiesBase that adds no members of its own) as the global level of the Configuration hierarchy for every database and shard-set endpoint in that collection
fields.postcondition: an Npgsql setting given once under PgGlobalSettings applies to every PostgreSQL connection unless a database, shard-set, read/write, shard or endpoint level overrides it
